World Junior Squash Champion Anahat Singh Honored

World junior squash champion Anahat Singh was felicitated in Delhi. Union Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya honored Anahat Singh and the men's squash team for their success in the World Junior Championship. Anahat Singh stated that Egyptian players do not hold a mental advantage. Another player, Esha Singh, was also felicitated by the Sports Authority of Telangana.
